row.evidence: Opsgenie's docs say 'Atlassian Guard Standard (formerly known as Atlassian Access) is billed separately and free with Opsgenie’s Standard and Enterprise plan', and the pricing comparison ticks Atlassian Guard Standard and Single Sign-On only for Standard and Enterprise.
row.notes: Status changed partial -> gated. June recorded SCIM as the Atlassian Guard Standard add-on (+$4/u/mo) on top of Essentials; Opsgenie's own docs now say Guard Standard is free with Opsgenie Standard and Enterprise, and the pricing table ticks it only for those tiers, so SCIM costs the Standard tier ($19.95 vs Essentials $9.45, annual). The June $4/u/mo Guard price is not on any page loaded here and is dropped. SCIM is Atlassian-organization SCIM 2.0 (Guard) once Opsgenie is switched to Atlassian login: it creates, updates and deactivates Atlassian accounts; Atlassian lists group sync only for Jira, Confluence and Trello, and does not say SCIM creates Opsgenie users (they are otherwise invited via the Users page or User API). Native Opsgenie SAML SSO (Okta, Entra, Google, OneLogin, Ping, ADFS, generic SAML) also exists, with JIT 'Provision new users on the first login'. Okta and Entra catalogue apps are SSO-only. New signups and sales have ended; Opsgenie is retired with migration to Jira Service Management required before April 5, 2027.

scim.notes: Provided by Atlassian Guard Standard at the Atlassian organization level after switching Opsgenie to Atlassian login; the SCIM base URL and API key are shown once in Atlassian Administration.

auth.token_source: Atlassian Administration > Security > User security > Identity providers > (directory) > Provisioning

deprovision.data_retained: Deleting a user in the IdP deactivates the Atlassian account; deletion is done from the Atlassian directory.

attributes.notes: Atlassian lists display name, email, organization, job title, timezone, department and preferred language as IdP-updatable attributes (SCIM attribute names not given on this page).

limitations.text: Atlassian lists group sync only for Jira, Confluence and Trello; Opsgenie is not mentioned.
Default groups cannot be managed via SCIM.
SCIM API keys expire one year after creation.
Opsgenie is end-of-sale; data must move to Jira Service Management before April 5, 2027.

rate_limits.text: Rate limits scale with plan and purchased seats; Enterprise highest, Free lowest.

okta.notes: Okta catalogue page ticks SAML and Workflows Connectors only.

fallbacks.other_sync: Atlassian organization provisioning (Guard) after switching to Atlassian login
